package tailwind

func AdamicNormalizeArgument(argument string) string {
    return normalizeValueFunctionArgument(argument)
}

func AdamicSegment(input string, separator byte) []string {
    return segment(input, separator)
}

// Only the oracle can seed the counter. Production state and behavior stay intact.
func AdamicCounterSequence(start int, count int) []int {
    builds.Lock()
    saved := builds.count
    builds.count = start
    builds.Unlock()
    result := make([]int, count)
    for index := range result { result[index] = nextBuildCount() }
    builds.Lock()
    builds.count = saved
    builds.Unlock()
    return result
}
